caption: The drawing depicts a metallic container with a lid and a handle, colored in shades of copper and brown, giving it a weathered appearance. The container is rectangular with rounded edges and is positioned horizontally. It has a thin, curved wire handle attached at both ends to the sides of the lid, and a smaller, fixed handle at the top of the lid. The container is sitting on a metal frame or stand that features multiple circular holes along its sides and some rusted areas, expressed through darker, mottled brown and black hues. The base of the stand includes two curved, elongated support legs that are riveted to its sides and splay out toward the ground. A broad strap or strip, also made of metal, is visible at the side of the base, looping outward. The overall composition is centered on a light, plain background.
title: Hot Water Goose
